summary: Nuvectis Pharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 5,000,000 shares of common stock at $20.00 per share, targeting $100 million in gross proceeds. The filing is a routine capital raise under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. The company, an emerging growth and smaller reporting company, granted underwriters a 30-day option for an additional 750,000 shares. Delivery is expected July 1, 2026. Sole bookrunner is Cantor with co-managers H.C. Wainwright, Laidlaw, Lucid Capital, Maxim Group, Roth Capital, and Titan Partners. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring elements; the event is purely an ordinary equity offering.
